cases.summary: Persist_mode for xdg portal does not work
cases.description:
### Bug Description

The portal dialog on wayland shows upon connecting but it is not possible to make the remote desktop session persistent.

### How to Reproduce

Connect to a wayland host.

### Expected Behavior

Persistent session 

### Operating system(s) on local side and remote side

wayland -> wayland (Fedora 39)

### RustDesk Version(s) on local side and remote side

nightly

### Screenshots

-

### Additional Context

_No response_

evidence.eventual_fix_title: Fix xdg portal verison check for persist_mode
evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
Fix xdg portal verison check for persist_mode

fixes #6741 on Fedora 39.

- version check mixed up `ScreenCast` and `RemoteDesktop` which added `persist_mode` and `restore_token` on versions `4` and `2`, respectively.
- injection of `persist_mode` and `restore_token` happened in a too late step of setting up the session
